label: Swap
description: Swap one Cardano token for another.

label: Cross-chain swap
description: Swap from an asset on another chain into a Cardano asset, or back.

label: Perpetuals
description: Open or close perpetual futures positions.

label: Provide liquidity
description: Deposit a token pair into an AMM pool for trading fees.

label: Stake protocol token
description: Stake a protocol's own token for rewards or governance weight.

label: Stability pool
description: Deposit a synthetic into a pool that absorbs liquidations for a share of the collateral.

label: Supply
description: Supply assets to a money market to earn interest.

label: Mint via CDP
description: Mint a synthetic asset against a collateralized debt position, or close one.

label: Mint stablecoin
description: Mint or redeem a reserve-backed stablecoin.

label: Balance
description: Read the ADA and native-asset balance of an address.

label: Send
description: Send ADA or native assets to an address.

label: Delegate
description: Delegate ADA to a stake pool.

label: Sign transaction
description: Sign and submit a transaction built elsewhere.

label: Positions
description: Read an address's open DeFi positions.
